changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: Clean singular names: ref.currency, ref.asset_class etc. -> VIEW on dim.dim_*
changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ref
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS master
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS market
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS macro
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ref.currency AS SELECT currency_id, currency_code AS code, currency_name AS name FROM dim.dim_currency
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ref.asset_class AS SELECT asset_class_id AS id, asset_class_code AS code, asset_class_name AS name FROM dim.dim_asset_class
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ref.industry AS SELECT industry_id AS id, industry_name AS name FROM dim.dim_industry
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ref.sector AS SELECT sector_id AS id, sector_name AS name, industry_id FROM dim.dim_sector
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ref.country AS SELECT country_iso3 AS code, country_name AS name FROM dim.dim_country
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ref.indicator AS SELECT indicator_id AS id, indicator_name AS name, source_id, unit FROM dim.dim_indicator
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ref.exchange AS SELECT exchange_id AS id, exchange_code AS code, exchange_name AS name, currency_id FROM dim.dim_exchange

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW master.instrument AS SELECT instrument_id AS id, symbol, name, asset_class_id, currency_id, sector_id, exchange_id FROM dim.dim_instrument
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW master.equity AS SELECT instrument_id AS id, outstanding_shares, market_cap FROM dim.dim_equity

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW master.instrument_detail AS SELECT i.instrument_id AS id, i.symbol, ac.asset_class_code, c.currency_code, s.sector_name FROM dim.dim_instrument i JOIN dim.dim_asset_class ac ON ac.asset_class_id=i.asset_class_id JOIN dim.dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=i.currency_id JOIN dim.dim_sector s ON s.sector_id=i.sector_id

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW market.ohlcv AS SELECT instrument_id, date AS trade_date, open, high, low, close, volume FROM dim.fact_market_ohlcv
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW macro.observation AS SELECT indicator_id, country_iso3, date AS observation_date, value FROM dim.fact_macro_observations
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW fact.market_ohlcv AS SELECT * FROM market.ohlcv
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW fact.macro_observation AS SELECT * FROM macro.observation
